criteria.support_condition: Representative records of completed projects above 50 MW establish 18–36 months as the ordinary construction-to-completion range, and sufficiently broad records of the largest facilities establish that no completed gigawatt facility or campus existed by May 12, 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative completed-project records show that the ordinary delivery range is materially outside 18–36 months, or reliable commissioning and capacity records identify a completed gigawatt facility or campus by May 12, 2026. An exceptional conversion or an early campus phase alone does not disprove the ordinary build-time claim.
